outlets.name: NBC News
outlets.summary: NBC News, covering US national news and politics is leading with Republicans fight red-state midterm chaos with hundreds of millions in late money; Local officials weigh in on political polarization; Cornell students protest handling of alleged 2024 sexual assault.

items.headline: Republicans fight red-state midterm chaos with hundreds of millions in late money
items.detail: Republicans have made more than $700 million of new advertising bookings in congressional races since Sept. 1, with the Trump-aligned super PAC pouring in funds.

items.headline: Local officials weigh in on political polarization
items.detail: NBC News' Megan Brand spoke to local officials about their views about the rise in political polarization in their communities.

items.headline: Cornell students protest handling of alleged 2024 sexual assault
items.detail: Students at Cornell University are protesting on campus over the handling of the alleged 2024 sexual assault. NBC News’ Maggie Vespa spoke with a sophomore who is calling for the resignation of administrators.

items.headline: Televangelist Jim Bakker dies at age 86
items.detail: Jim Bakker, the televangelist who rose to fame with the PTL network in the 1970s, but was later convicted of fraud and conspiracy, has died at the age of 86.

items.headline: Inside NATO operation to protect European countries from Russia
items.detail: A NATO mission in Europe is defending against hundreds of Russian drones and aircraft that have been entering alliance airspace.

outlets.name: The Hill
outlets.summary: The Hill, reporting on Congress, the White House and US policy is leading with Trump's Golden Dome faces headwinds with funding uncertain; Alito's first book pushes conservative justice into spotlight; Hegseth's get-out-the-vote effort draws praise and skepticism.

items.headline: Trump's Golden Dome faces headwinds with funding uncertain
items.detail: Golden Dome, President Trump’s lofty plan for a national ballistic missile defense shield, is facing heavy headwinds with project funding still uncertain.

items.headline: Alito's first book pushes conservative justice into spotlight
items.detail: Two decades after joining the Supreme Court, Justice Samuel Alito joins the ranks of justices as authors.

items.headline: Hegseth's get-out-the-vote effort draws praise and skepticism
items.detail: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is ramping up his get-out-the-vote campaign, urging U.S. troops to register to vote in the 2026 midterm elections but not telling them which way to vote.

items.headline: Trump’s feud with Cotton snaps heads in the Senate
items.detail: President Trump’s doxing of Sen. Tom Cotton over a stalled bill to establish year-round daylight saving time is throwing an unexpected twist in the Arkansas Republican’s reelection race and sets up a fierce fight in the Senate this fall…

items.headline: Trump is turning out Democrats, but can he still do it for the GOP?
items.detail: We’re now over the hump and into the downhill slide to the end of the 2026 midterm elections. I say “end” because early voting has already begun in six states, and by the end of next week, the number will be up to 19 and counting.

items.headline: MasterClass Launches Podcast ‘Other People’s Business’ With Martha Stewart as First Guest
items.detail: MasterClass is getting into the podcast business. The online learning and streaming platform has launched “Other People’s Business,” its first-ever podcast, hosted by MasterClass founder and CEO David Rogier.

items.headline: Darius Jabloński, Kadri Kousaar and Rodrigo Susarte Make the Cut at Tallinn TV Beats Co-Financing Market (EXCLUSIVE)
items.detail: Polish film and TV luminary Darius Jabloński’s spy thriller “Fortel” and Estonia’s “Stormbird” from multi-awarded Kadri Kousaar (“Magnus,” “Mother”) feature in the lineup of Tallinn’s TV Beats Co-Financing Market, running over Nov. 16-17.

items.headline: Michael Douglas Weighs In on ‘Nepo Baby’ Debate, Says the Title ‘Really Pisses Me Off’
items.detail: Michael Douglas is wading into the “nepo baby” debate. The “Wall Street” actor, who is the son of the late Hollywood legend Kirk Douglas, opened up on a recent episode of the “SmartLess” podcast and said the title “really pisses” him off.

items.headline: Jon Stewart’s ‘Daily Show’ Skips David Ellison-Skydance News to Take on AI
items.detail: On Sunday night, John Oliver dedicated the majority of his Emmy-winning show “Last Week Tonight” to the Secret Service’s failings in recent years while declining to address the major media news of the week: David Ellison’s newly-formed…

items.headline: ‘Artificial’ Review: Luca Guadagnino Has Made the Real Sequel to ‘The Social Network’ — a Brain-Spinning Tech-Geek Docudrama, Brilliantly Acted by Andrew Garfield and Yura Borisov
items.detail: "Artificial" is a brilliant but playful docudrama, meticulously true to history, that focuses on the founders of OpenAI, notably its CEO Sam Altman (Andrew Garfield). But the tale it tells is much larger than that.

outlets.name: Bloomberg
outlets.summary: Bloomberg's markets and business file is leading with Apollo to Favor Aircraft Funding Over Junk Bonds for EasyJet; Emera to Buy Canadian Utilities in C$14.3 Billion Deal (EMA CN, CU CN); S&P 500 Targets Record as Bonds Climb and Oil Dips: Markets Wrap.

items.headline: Apollo to Favor Aircraft Funding Over Junk Bonds for EasyJet
items.detail: Apollo Global Management is set to opt for aircraft financing rather than high yield bonds for a £3.5 billion debt package backing its acquisition of low-cost carrier EasyJet Plc.

items.headline: Emera to Buy Canadian Utilities in C$14.3 Billion Deal (EMA CN, CU CN)
items.detail: Emera Inc. will acquire ATCO-controlled Canadian Utilities Ltd. in an approximately C$14.3 billion ($10 billion) all-share transaction, in what they say would be the largest merger between two Canadian companies.

items.headline: S&P 500 Targets Record as Bonds Climb and Oil Dips: Markets Wrap
items.detail: The S&P 500 is set to move closer to its first record high since August in a broad advance in global stocks as bonds climbed and a slide in oil prices helped ease worries over inflation.

items.headline: Mideast Oil Flows Are Near 80% of Prewar Levels, Shell CEO Says
items.detail: Oil flows from the Middle East are at about 80% of pre-conflict volumes, the chief executive officer of Shell Plc said, offering one of the most authoritative assessments yet of how the region’s exports are rebounding.

items.headline: Gold Reverses Losses With Inflation Fears Easing as Oil Slips
items.detail: Gold edged higher, reversing early losses as falling oil prices and a rebound in bond markets helped to ease worries about inflation and the trajectory for interest rates.

items.headline: Former German spy chief arrested for espionage and treason
items.detail: August Hanning is accused of obtaining classified information for a foreign power.

items.headline: Trump says 'threat' led US to pull bombers from RAF Fairford
items.detail: The Pentagon confirmed on Sunday it had removed the B1 bombers from the base in England back to their home stations in America.

items.headline: Fort Hood shooter to be executed by firing squad - a first for US military since World War Two
items.detail: Nidal Malik Hasan killed 13 unarmed soldiers and injured another 32 in the deadliest ever non-combat attack on an American military base.

items.headline: 'Ghost particles' from space telescope wins physics Nobel
items.detail: Belgian physicist Prof Francis Halzen has won for his pioneering work on an observatory that detects particles from space.

items.headline: Sailors missing after fresh attacks on Black Sea vessels, Bulgaria says
items.detail: It is not clear who is behind the attacks which come as Russia intensifies strikes in the Black Sea as part of its war against Ukraine.

items.detail: François Picard is pleased to welcome Philip Ingram, journalist and former British military intelligence officer. The events surrounding RAF Fairford are not an isolated incident, explains Ingram.

items.detail: France braced on Tuesday for a day of nationwide high-school ​blockades and trade union-led street protests in support of students demanding that President Emmanuel Macron's cash-strapped government tackle understaffed and dilapidated…

items.headline: Should we be worried about a plague outbreak in Russia?
items.detail: PRESS REVIEW – Tuesday, October 6: The death of a researcher in Siberia, reportedly from the plague, sparks concern despite Russian authorities' denial.

items.headline: Yemen's Houthis claim attack on Riyadh airport
items.detail: Yemen's Houthis claimed an attack on the main airport in the Saudi capital while also denying on Tuesday losing territory to government forces, as fighting intensified.

items.detail: Minister announces referrals after think tank paper finds link between purchases and unannounced MRT stations.

items.headline: Saudi Arabia says three wounded in attacks on airports near Yemen border
items.detail: Saudi aviation authority reports severe injuries and damage following Houthi strikes on Jazan and Najran airports.

items.headline: Fort Hood shooter to be executed by firing squad: All to know
items.detail: The US Army is averse to capital punishment and has not carried out an execution in decades.

items.headline: UEFA to investigate spitting incident at Ireland-Israel football match
items.detail: An Israeli player is accused of spitting on an Irish coach as the teams returned to their dressing rooms at half-time.

items.headline: Kenya ministry of health confirms first imported Ebola case
items.detail: The first imported case of Ebola has been recorded in Kenya.
